Local landscaping

Landscaping in Harrington Park, finished to suit the street

Harrington Park is a master-planned estate where the streetscape sets a high bar. Gardens here are expected to look considered and stay that way, so material choice, clean lines and planting that suits the setting all count. We design and build to that standard.

One licensed local team handles design through to maintenance, quotes a fixed price after seeing the block, and never charges a call-out fee.

props.label: Section
props.html:
FAQs

Landscaping in Harrington Park: your questions answered

Can you match the finish expected on a Harrington Park street?
Yes. We plan material, line and planting to suit a premium frontage and the established streetscape, and quote a fixed price so the finish is agreed before we start.
Do you offer ongoing garden maintenance in Harrington Park?
Yes. We do regular maintenance, mowing, hedging and seasonal care, on a per-visit or planned basis, so an established garden keeps looking its best.
Do you charge a call-out fee?
No. Coming out to look at your job and quote it is free, every time. You only pay once you accept a fixed-price quote and we get to work.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, we are a licensed contractor. We are happy to show our credentials before any work starts, so you know exactly who is on your property.
How soon can you start?
Often quickly, especially for smaller jobs and quotes. We are open 7am to 7pm, 7 days, so call 0451 267 287 and we will tell you honestly what we can do.
